name: agent-loop
description: Agent-guided single-human development loop with adaptive lightweight changes, full Feature workflows, and explicit human gates.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-guided development loop from goal intake to verified close
interface.longDescription: The agent acts as controller: inspects project state, classifies the entry scenario, loads stage-specific references, produces or updates agent-loop artifacts, and stops at human gates. Feature behavior uses the full TDD workflow; bounded ordinary non-Bug changes use an adaptive response-local card and targeted verification.
defaultPrompt: I want to initialize agent-loop for this project.
